{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify QA orders (revenue == '999999.99')
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Check if QA orders are in the dataset
print("Number of QA orders:", len(qa_orders))

# Check their conversion status
print("QA orders converted values:", qa_orders['converted'].tolist())

# Check their customer_segment distribution
print("QA orders by customer_segment:\n", qa_orders['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check if any QA orders are in the 'completed' status
print("QA orders status:", qa_orders['status'].value_counts())"}
